title: What Eviction Destroys: A Restore-Counterfactual Audit of Forgetting in Agent Memory
title_zh: 驱逐会摧毁什么：对智能体记忆遗忘的恢复反事实审计
abstract_en: Agent memory systems must discard stored information when their history exceeds a fixed token budget. Existing budget-accuracy frontiers quantify the resulting loss in accuracy, but do not distinguish irreversible losses caused by eviction from recoverable retrieval failures. We introduce the restore counterfactual, a per-question paired intervention that reinstates the question's gold evidence in the read-time context and reruns the same reader. Combining the change in correctness with whether the evidence was retained after eviction classifies each oracle-answerable error as recoverable, irreversible, or residual; in the residual case, the answer remains incorrect after restoration. We evaluate FIFO, random, redundancy-aware, and LLM-importance eviction on LongMemEval-S at three budgets and under two retrieval regimes, using GPT-4o-mini as the primary reader and judge and GPT-5.4-mini as a robustness reader. Under top-k retrieval at an 80k-token budget, the irreversible share among errors corrected by restoration is 0.67-0.73 for FIFO, random, and redundancy-aware eviction, compared with 0.60 for LLM-importance. At 8k tokens, it reaches 1.00 for all four policies. Recoverable errors occur under top-k retrieval at 80k tokens but are absent under forced-gold injection by construction, so budget-accuracy results are not directly comparable unless the retrieval regime is reported. An exploratory matched-accuracy analysis detects no difference in irreversible rate among accuracy-matched policy pairs at a resolution of 1.2-6 percentage points. The same analysis detects the deliberately destructive control. To our knowledge, this is the first per-item, per-question restore-counterfactual audit of eviction for external agent-memory stores on a standard conversational benchmark.
abstract_zh: 智能体记忆系统在历史超过固定 token 预算时必须丢弃信息。既有预算—准确率曲线只能衡量总体性能损失，无法区分由驱逐造成的不可逆损失与可通过检索修复的失败。本文提出“恢复反事实”（restore counterfactual）：针对每个问题，将其金标准证据重新注入读取时上下文，并使用同一 reader 重新作答。结合答案正确性变化与证据是否在驱逐后保留，将可由 oracle 作答的问题错误划分为可恢复、不可逆和残余错误。作者在 LongMemEval-S 上评估 FIFO、random、redundancy-aware 和 LLM-importance 四种驱逐策略，覆盖三种预算与两种检索机制，并以 GPT-4o-mini 作为主要 reader/judge、GPT-5.4-mini 进行稳健性验证。在 top-k retrieval、80k token 预算下，被恢复修正的错误中，不可逆错误占比为：FIFO、random、redundancy-aware 的 0.67–0.73，LLM-importance 为 0.60；在 8k 预算下，四种策略均达到 1.00。可恢复错误只出现在 top-k retrieval 的 80k 设置中，在 forced-gold injection 下按构造不存在，因此不报告检索机制时，预算—准确率结果不可直接比较。探索性的准确率匹配分析未发现策略对之间不可逆率存在差异，同时能够检测出人为设计的破坏性控制。该工作据称首次在标准对话基准上，对外部智能体记忆存储中的驱逐进行逐样本、逐问题的恢复反事实审计。
key_points_zh: 提出 restore counterfactual：恢复问题的 gold evidence 后，用同一 reader 重跑，以隔离驱逐造成的真实损失。
将 oracle-answerable 错误划分为 recoverable、irreversible 和 residual，区分检索失败、不可逆遗忘与模型自身错误。
在 LongMemEval-S 上，80k token 的 top-k retrieval 中，恢复修正错误的不可逆占比为 0.60–0.73；8k 预算下四种策略均为 1.00。
FIFO、random、redundancy-aware 与 LLM-importance 的不可逆率在准确率匹配比较中未显示明显差异，但该方法能识别故意破坏的控制条件。
预算—准确率结果高度依赖检索机制；forced-gold injection 不产生 recoverable errors，因而不能与普通 top-k retrieval 直接比较。

llm_assessment.comment: The restore-counterfactual protocol offers a rigorous and broadly reusable way to separate irreversible forgetting from retrieval failures in Agent memory.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 恢复反事实评估协议为区分 Agent Memory 中不可逆遗忘与可恢复检索失败提供了严谨且通用的方法。
